Secarang > Confirmation (Car Owner Details: Full Name) > Payment > Success page; Secarang > CIBO > Transaction Management > Transaction Details
Staging Test:

(Ref. No = BR6N006388, Vehicle No = JLX8382, Receipt No = 26110421300001, FPX RHB, 04-11-2026 14:21; Ref. No = BR6N006389, Vehicle No = JXP4235, Receipt No = 26110421300002, FPX Maybank, 04-11-2026 15:06; working comparison: Ref. No = BR6N006385, Vehicle No = BPX823, Full Name "MONG TEST ALLIANZ 2", 03-11-2026)

Allianz on the real UAT API: two purchases with the Full Name "QA SECARANG TEST" were paid but the policy was refused. The car, IC, gender and bank were different each time; only the name was the same.
Item / Step to Simulate
Actual Result
Expected Result
1. Allianz purchase with Full Name "QA SECARANG TEST"
On Secarang Home (staging/ia), enter a real plate + owner IC + postcode 55000 and get quotations.
Choose Allianz, keep the default add-ons, Continue.
On Confirmation, type Full Name "QA SECARANG TEST" and the other owner details, then Confirm and Pay.
Pay by FPX (status 00 Approved).
In CIBO > Transaction Management, search the plate and open Transaction Details.
Payment is taken and Secarang shows "Payment successful!" with a receipt.
CIBO: Payment Paid, but Transaction Status
Failed
, Remark
"Invalid fullName"
Cover Note No and Policy No are
; no Receipt or e-Certificate button on Transaction Details.
Same on both purchases (BR6N006388 and BR6N006389). See screenshots 1 and 2 below.
The name is accepted and the purchase completes: Transaction Status
"Insurance created"
, with Cover Note No and Policy No filled, as for the Dev's made-up name "MONG TEST ALLIANZ 2" (BR6N006385, Insurance created).
Per SRD v1.1, Section 2.1.3a: the full Allianz journey (quote, add-ons, payment, cover note, callbacks, receipt) must work end to end. See screenshot 3 below.
Note:
Dev confirmed on 04-11-2026 that this is a bug. If the name must follow a rule (e.g. the IC owner's name, or no short words), Secarang should check it on Confirmation before payment, not after.

Screenshot 2 - Actual: CIBO Transaction Management, BR6N006389 (JXP4235): Failed, "Invalid fullName" (IC masked)
